title: centaurea uniflora var. helvetica
intro: Centaurea uniflora var. helvetica, commonly known as Alpine Knapweed, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Knapweed include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
